title: Welcome
subtitle: A tiny deck builder with big feelings

image.alt: Riso-style retro projector beaming a confetti of pastel slides

headline: Why Slide-o-Matic?
body: Make a slideshow like you would leave a voicemail: fast, warm, and done.
Everything saves in your browser. No accounts, no cloud lock-in, no fuss.
Double-click any text right on a slide to rewrite it on the spot.

image.alt: Riso retro microphone singing slides into the air

headline: Three keys and the room is rolling
body: That's the whole learning curve. Press **?** anytime for the full list.

pillars.title: E: Edit
pillars.text: Opens the workbench. Rewrite text, swap layouts, drop in photos, or pick a theme.

pillars.title: S: Settings
pillars.text: Opens deck settings. Shuffle themes, set type weight, share a link, or export PDF and JSON.

pillars.title: O: Overview
pillars.text: Zooms out to see every slide at once. Jump anywhere in one click.

headline: Pick a shape, then make it land

left.headline: 10 built-in shapes
left.body: Title, Standard, Scroll, Split (like this one), Pillars, Grid, Gallery, Quote, Image, and Typeface. Switch a slide's type anytime without losing the words.

right.headline: Zero layout math
right.body: No nudging text boxes by two pixels. Write the point; the slide handles the proportions, borders, and mobile layout.

headline: Drop, paste, or search for photos
body: Drag files onto a slide, paste from clipboard, or hit **🔍** to pull free shots from Pexels and Unsplash.

image.alt: Riso collage of cassette tape, vinyl record, boombox, and guitar

headline: Flip the vibe in one keystroke
body: Press **S** and hit **Shuffle Theme** to spin a fresh color palette.
Open **E → Theme** to switch between Default, Vaporwave, Slack, and Gameboy—or save a custom palette.
Press **R** to flip on the built-in SomaFM radio dock while building or presenting.

image.alt: Riso chameleon mid color-change on a paint swatch wheel

headline: “Bless the mess. Compress the chaos. Ship the thing.”
Ready when you are
body: Press **E** (or double-click this headline) to edit right over this deck—your changes auto-save to your browser.
Want a structure to fill in? Head home and grab **The Pitch**, **The Talk**, **Show & Tell**, or **The Weird One**.
When you're done, hit **Share** for a link, **D** for a JSON backup, or export a **PDF**.
